title: Uniquely normalized integral scalar pullback comparison by good localization
statement: For a finite coefficient extension E→L and a scheme morphism f:X→Y, there is a unique natural isomorphism from integralDerivedPullback over E followed by ordinary derived scalar extension on X to ordinary derived scalar extension on Y followed by integralDerivedPullback over L. Its component on every good complex satisfies exactly scalarPullbackOrdinaryNormalization: conjugation by the two good pullback comparisons and the exact scalar factorization identifies it with the prescribed scalarPullbackChain. This is the unchanged normalized-existence clause of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension, extracted as a completely proved lemma to meet the per-file compile limit.

source.place: Tensor reassociation, evaluation and coefficient comparisons; scalar-comparison proof step 9 of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension; Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08J9 and 08TC.

proof.text: Use the proved uniquely normalized pullback chain natural isomorphism on good representatives. The good inclusion followed by Q localizes at quasi-isomorphisms, so restriction is fully faithful. Apply functorSquareRepresentativeDescent with the good scalar lift, the two derived pullback representative comparisons, and exact scalar mapDerivedCategoryFactors. The resulting normalization is exactly scalarPullbackOrdinaryNormalization by its definition and the prescribed hom components of the good chain comparison. The descent lemma proves existence, invertibility, and uniqueness. All statements and normalization data of the original clause are preserved; no new hole or construction from arbitrary existence is introduced.

theorem normalizedIntegralScalarPullbackComparison {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃! α : integralDerivedPullback l E f ⋙ integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι X ≅
      integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι Y ⋙ integralDerivedPullback l L f,
      scalarPullbackOrdinaryNormalization l E L ι f α
